name: Crater Salvage
description: 27 gold coins, a few silver, 4 emeralds, a ruby, half a necklace, a cracked goblet, a bent spoon, 6 pearls, a brass button. All of it smells of him.

name: Participation Coin
description: Plastic, the gold coming off. TREASURE IS ABOUT THE JOURNEY! VALUE: GREAT MEMORIES. NO CASH VALUE. You threw it at him. He gave it back.

name: Grand Award Ribbon
description: Grand prize for finding treasure for somebody else. Excellence in accidental shark enrichment. Far too much glitter. It stuck to you.

name: Garrick's Book
description: The Grand Expedition for the Lost Fart: Complete Grand Stenchmaster Legends - Volume One of Probably Many. Crayon. Not a source.

name: Counter-Storm Plan
description: Your notes, from POSITION SHIP NEAR VORTEX to RECOVER DIGNITY. LOCAL SEA MAY REEK 50-53 TIMES WORSE (HE SAYS). STILL CONSIDERING IT.
